10x: When your portfolio goes up 1000%. Usually happens right after you sell.
100x: The dream. The myth. The reason we are all here.
51% attack: When a single entity controls more than half the network's hash rate. Basically, centralization with extra steps.
address: Your crypto mailbox. Don't doxx yourself.
airdrop: Free money falling from the sky. Usually worth $0.50 after gas fees.
algo: Algorand. Great tech, terrible price action.
ath: All Time High. The price you bought at.
atl: All Time Low. The price you sold at.
altcoin: Any coin that isn't Bitcoin. 99.9% are scams.
alpha: Insider info or early knowledge. Usually just a rumor from a Discord server.
ama: Ask Me Anything. Usually 'When marketing?' and 'When Binance?'.
aml: Anti-Money Laundering. The reason CEXs freeze your funds.
ape: To buy blindly without research. A valid investment strategy.
arbitrage: Buying low on one exchange, selling high on another. Bots will beat you to it.
ashdrake: A trader who shorts all of the BTC.
atomic swap: Exchanging coins across chains without a bridge. Magic internet money wizardry.
audit: A security check that doesn't guarantee the contract won't get exploited anyway.
bag: The coins you are holding. Hopefully not heavy.
bagholder: Someone holding a coin that has crashed. 'Community member'.
banana zone: Real Vision term for when prices go parabolic.
bank run: When everyone tries to withdraw at once and the CEX says 'maintenance'.
based: Being yourself and not caring what others think. Also means 'good' in degen speak.
bear: Someone who thinks the market will go down. They are usually right, but we hate them.
bear market: When everything goes down for 2 years. Time to build (or cry).
bear trap: A fake drop before a pump. Designed to liquidate shorts.
bearwhale: A whale who is bearish. A massive obstacle.
beta: Volatility relative to the market. Altcoins are high beta.
binance: The final boss of exchanges. Funds are safu (mostly).
bitcoin: The King. Digital Gold. The only thing that matters.
bitcoin maxi: Someone who thinks everything else is a shitcoin. They aren't wrong.
black swan: An unexpected event that nukes the market. e.g., FTX, Luna, COVID.
block: A page in the ledger. Don't miss it.
blockchain: A slow, expensive database. But it's decentralized!
block explorer: Where you go to see your failed transactions.
bollinger bands: Squiggly lines traders use to pretend they know the future.
bonding curve: A mathematical line that makes early buyers rich and late buyers rekt.
bot: Automated trading script. They frontrun your trades.
bounty: Rewards for doing tasks. Usually engaging with tweets.
bridge: A protocol to move tokens between chains. The most hackable part of crypto.
btil: Buy The F***ing Dip. Not financial advice.
bubble: Every bull market. It pops eventually.
build: What devs do in a bear market.
bull trap: A fake pump before a dump. Designed to liquidate longs.
burn: Destroying tokens to increase scarcity. Marketing gimmick.
buy the dip: Investing when prices drop. Catching a falling knife.
buy wall: Massive buy orders preventing price drop. Usually spoofed.
candle: Visual representation of price action. Green is good, red is pain.
capitulation: Giving up and selling everything. Usually the bottom.
cash out: Turning crypto into fiat. Weak mindset.
cex: Centralized Exchange. Not your keys, not your coins.
chad: A successful degen. High conviction, massive gains.
circulating supply: Tokens available now. Watch out for unlocks.
cliff: When vested tokens unlock all at once. Dump incoming.
cloud mining: A scam where you pay someone else to not mine bitcoin for you.
coin: A cryptocurrency with its own native chain.
cold storage: Offline wallet. The only safe place.
collateral: Assets you lock up to borrow stablecoins. Don't get liquidated.
confirmations: Waiting for blocks to be finalized. Nerves of steel required.
consensus: How nodes agree on the truth.
convergence: When prices of related assets meet.
correction: A dip. 'Healthy' if you are bullish, 'Crash' if you are bearish.
cpi: Consumer Price Index. Inflation data that nukes the market.
cross-chain: Interoperability. The dream of seamless transfer.
custody: Who holds your keys. Self-custody is the way.
cypherpunk: Original crypto anarchists. Code is Law.
dao: Decentralized Autonomous Organization. A Discord group with a bank account.
dapp: Decentralized Application. A website that connects to your wallet.
dark pool: Private trading for whales. No impact on charts.
dead cat bounce: A temporary recovery in a crash.
death cross: Bearish chart pattern. 50 MA crosses below 200 MA.
defi: Decentralized Finance. Banking without banks (and without refunds).
deflationary: Supply decreases over time. 'Number go up' technology.
delist: When an exchange removes a coin. RIP.
derivative: Betting on the price of something without owning it.
dex: Decentralized Exchange. Uniswap, Raydium. Trade with smart contracts.
diamond hands: Refusing to sell, even at -90%. Hero or fool.
difficulty: How hard it is to mine a block.
dildo: A massive green or red candle.
dip: Price drop. A buying opportunity (or the start of a crash).
discord: Where DAOs live. Turn off DMs to avoid scams.
diversification: Buying different coins to lose money in multiple ways.
dominance: Bitcoin's share of the total market.
double spend: Sending the same coin twice. Why we need consensus.
dust: Tiny amounts of crypto left in a wallet. Unspendable.
dyor: Do Your Own Research. Legal disclaimer for shilling.
early: Getting in before the masses. 100x potential.
eli5: Explain Like I'm 5. 'Money printer go brrr'.
emission: Rate of new tokens being created. Inflation.
escrow: Middleman for trades. Trustless is better.
etf: Exchange Traded Fund. Boomer institutional money.
exchange: Where you trade. CEX or DEX.
exit liquidity: The people buying when you are selling.
financial advice: Something I am definitely NOT giving you.
flippening: When ETH market cap overtakes BTC. (Hasn't happened yet).
floor price: Lowest price for an NFT collection.
fomo: Fear Of Missing Out. Buying the top because your friends did.
fractional: Owning a piece of an asset.
front run: Bots buying before you to raise the price.
fud: Fear, Uncertainty, Doubt. Negative news (even if true).
fundamental analysis: Looking at tech and team. Doesn't matter in a bull run.
futures: Betting on future price. Leverage trading.
gamefi: Play to Earn. Usually grinding for pennies.
gas: Fee to pay for transaction. Gwei.
gas limit: Max gas you are willing to pay.
gas war: Spending life savings to mint an NFT.
gem: Low cap coin with high potential.
gm: Good Morning. We recognize each other.
golden cross: Bullish chart pattern. 50 MA crosses above 200 MA.
halving: Bitcoin supply cut in half every 4 years. Bull run catalyst.
hodl: Hold On for Dear Life. A typo that became a religion.
honeypot: A token you can buy but can't sell.
hot wallet: Wallet connected to the internet. MetaMask.
howey test: How the SEC decides if you are a security.
il: Impermanent Loss. Losing money while providing liquidity.
instamine: Mining a lot of coins at launch. Unfair.
investor: Someone who failed to swing trade.
ipfs: InterPlanetary File System. Where NFTs live.
jeet: Someone who sells for a tiny profit. Weak hands.
kyc: Know Your Customer. Send your ID to a hacked database.
l1: Layer 1. Base blockchain. BTC, ETH, SOL.
l2: Layer 2. Scaling solution. Arb, Op, Base.
leverage: Trading with borrowed money. Fast way to get rekt.
liquidity: Available assets in a pool. Depth.
margin call: Add more money or get liquidated.
market order: Buying immediately at any price. Slippage city.
mixer: Tool to obscure transaction history. Tornado Cash.
mt gox: The original exchange hack. Forced HODL.
ngmi: Not Gonna Make It. You sold or bought bad coins.
nocoiner: Someone with no crypto. Have fun staying poor.
oracle: Data feed for smart contracts. Chainlink.
order book: List of buy and sell orders.
paper hands: Selling at the first sign of a dip.
ponzi: Scheme where new money pays old money. 90% of crypto.
profit: Selling for more than you bought. Myth.
pump and dump: Artificial pump followed by a crash.
sec: Securities and Exchange Commission. The enemy.
shill: Promoting a coin typically for personal gain.
snapshot: Record of balances at a specific time.
stablecoin: Token pegged to fiat. USDT, USDC.
tokenomics: Economics of a token. Supply, vesting, utility.
whale: Someone with a lot of money.
zoom out: Look at the big picture (when in doubt).
